ocr.notes: readable but left-edge letters dropped and several garbled phrases

title.suggested: Ned O'Baldwin Killed; Allen Recalls His Career

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported the shooting death of Ned O'Baldwin in New York, with his record told by Tom Allen, who had bested him in a St. Louis glove contest and was negotiating a match with him.

metadata.notes: masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Thursday Morning, September 30, 1875

facts.fact: At a St. Louis benefit exhibition for the sufferers of the Chicago fire, Allen faced Ned O'Baldwin with gloves and clearly outclassed him; Jack Looney then offered $5,000 to back Allen in a match, but O'Baldwin's backers lacked the money
From late June 1875 there was talk of a match between Allen and O'Baldwin; Allen believed it would have taken place the next spring had O'Baldwin lived

notes: Allen was interviewed at his saloon on Washington Avenue. Most of the article is O'Baldwin's own record, which is not about Allen.
